properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 19 at 7:59PM MDT until October 19 at 8:15PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
At 759 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Leasburg,
moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Leasburg, Radium Springs, East Mesa, Portions of Jornada Experimental
Range, Hill, Northeast Las Cruces, and Fort Selden State Historic
Site.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 19 at 7:53PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
At 752 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 5 miles southwest of Akela to 13 miles east of
Columbus. Movement was east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Afton, Deming Ranchettes, Las Cruces West Mesa, Southern New Mexico
State Fairgrounds, Aden Crater, Mount Riley, Camel Mountain, and
Kilbourne Hole.

This includes Interstate 10 in New Mexico between mile markers 111
and 133.
properties.instruction:
Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, southeast winds 15 to
25 kt with gusts up to 40 kt expected. For the Gale Warning,
southeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 6
to 8 ft expected. For the second Small Craft Advisory, seas 6 to
8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Sumner Strait.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, from 1 AM to 1 PM
AKDT Tuesday. For the Gale Warning, from 1 PM to 7 PM AKDT
Tuesday. For the second Small Craft Advisory, from 7 PM to 10
PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
